description: A3 task 13: Setup and error screens re-proved on Round 7 (REQ-025, REQ-028; JOURNEY-025 and JOURNEY-028, completion owner). check-01 proves on the real components: /onboarding under the product presentation (no equipmentSetupDraft) starts from the empty draft and walks all five onboarding steps under Round 7's setup head — clr-setup-header with the Set up CLEAR title over clr-setup-progress, Step N of 5, in Screen's one pinned head — whose header hands its own closing rule to the head on the header itself (the shared Screen: a header joined by a pinned layer gives up its rule; shell.css's header rule outranks Round 7's .clr-setup-header rule, so in a browser the route had drawn two dividers); the title stays pinned in the setup header while the setup commits and after a failed commit; no production module supplies a setup draft; the released ErrorView (src/ui/view-state.tsx, unchanged) keeps the error role on frame, accent bar, emission and glyph, its retry and the one-owner rule. The route-level journeys are e2e/refinement/task-025.spec.ts (JOURNEY-025, rewritten for Round 7's head) and e2e/refinement/task-028.spec.ts (JOURNEY-028, carried), run under their own manifests. parity is the look check: each real route beside its accepted gallery state (bec4454) with matched data at 320 and 390 px — /onboarding's equipment step (Dumbbells ticked) beside the screens state's Setup part, a static composition, compared in words and in the pinned head's geometry (title, step line beneath it from the same edge, one divider closing the head and spanning it, the content starting at it, the head still while the content scrolls, no sticky overlay) and in how the equipment choices are drawn (the part's sample chips beside the route's shipped checkbox rows, labelled); /summary's failed session read beside ?state=errors in each of the four skins, compared in words, in every element's box within 2 px and in the painted roles. Every visible difference must be labelled with the criterion that intends it, and each case writes its receipt to evidence/refinement/task-113/parity/. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-113 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/app/Onboarding.test.tsx src/ui/view-state.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
